instructions:
Romanian business data for AI agents: the official ONRC company registry (4.2M firms), Ministry of Finance filings, and website/domain enrichment, all from Romanian government open data loaded locally.

Which tool: lookup_business for a firm by name or CUI (start here); lookup_director when you know a person; lookup_by_category to find firms by activity rather than name; extract_contacts or lookup_domain for a website; lookup_financials and lookup_financial_ratios for money; enrich_company for one firm's full profile in a single call. watch_company and watch_caen register monitors, and poll_watchlist returns what changed.

Search is diacritic-insensitive: pass plain ASCII ('paval' matches 'PAVAL').

Cite the date: every company result, list, financial answer and watch carries asOf {registry, financialYear, anaf}. When you quote registry data, say it is as of the ONRC snapshot of asOf.registry (e.g. 'as of the ONRC snapshot of 2 Sept 2026'); name asOf.financialYear with figures and asOf.anaf with VAT or inactive status.

Coverage: a first look, not a full check. risk.level 'ok' only means no distress signal in the ONRC statuses and ANAF flags held; the insolvency bulletin (BPI), ANAF tax debts, court cases and shareholders are not checked (risk.notChecked; https://leadgen.adrianhomelab.com/en/coverage). Never call a firm clean, safe or solvent on this data alone: say what was not checked.

Limits: 5 lookups per day anonymously, 25 per day with a free API key - an email address, no payment - from https://leadgen.adrianhomelab.com/start. get_usage shows what is left today (free, not counted). report_issue tells the founder what is missing or wrong (free, not counted). REST API docs: https://leadgen.adrianhomelab.com/docs

Plans: free during launch - every tool works within the limits above. When paid plans go live, full financial history, ratios and health score, financial filters (revenue, headcount, VAT, main activity) and CSV move to Pro (https://leadgen-checkout.adrianhomelab.com/).

tools.description: Look up a Romanian company by name or CUI (tax code) in the official ONRC registry of 4.2M firms. Diacritic-insensitive ('paval' finds 'PAVAL'); a CUI matches exactly. The first call for a named Romanian company. Ranked with a score: live firms first (exact name, then words), closed ones after; county lifts. For 'firms that do X in Y', use lookup_by_category (an empty result may carry a hint naming it).
